newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 1.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY RADIO NOON HEADLINES - NOV 1.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- A parliament investigative committee is likely to declare the work of certain members in a committee, which accounts Russia's state debt to Hungary, irreconcilable with their other activities.
- The opposition party Fidesz unveiled another privatisation abuse, in the case of the sale of Taverna hotel.
- Romanian citizens can vote at several places in Hungary at the week-end, when Romania will hold elections.
- Hungary and Germany have signed a military technology agreement.
- The Assembly of the Capital have been trying for hours to decide if a contract with a lawyers' office was legal or not.
